name: One Mile Campground
note: Gunnison NF campground in Taylor Canyon, 18 mi from Gunnison, with river access for rafting and trout fishing. 18 electric sites (15/30 amp, no water hookups) taking rigs of 30-99 ft. Reservable on recreation.gov. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: RIDB facility 232156 (reservable): 18 bookable sites, all electric (RV ELECTRIC 9, STANDARD ELECTRIC 9), max vehicle length 30-99 ft; recreation.gov page live with 90 reviews (read 2026-10-02). Surfaced by the CO private-gap list (RV Life row) - missed by the federal RIDB gap passes
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 900 m frame) around 38.7289,-106.7566: the Taylor River runs along the north side of the canyon road; the campground sits south of the road under continuous conifer canopy, sites not legible - not waterfront

name: North Park Campground (State Forest State Park)
note: Colorado Parks and Wildlife campground on CO-14 near Gould, the former Walden KOA now part of State Forest State Park: about 30 full-hookup sites (30/50 amp, pull-throughs) with showers, laundry and a playground. Reservable via CPW (cpwshop.com, 800-244-5613); 14-night limit. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: CPW: the former KOA property incorporated into State Forest State Park as North Park Campground, ~30 full-hookup sites, reservable through CPW (web search of CPW-sourced listings, 2026-10-02); Google 4.3 over 41 with phone; RV Life lists it as North Park Campground (formerly North Park Walden KOA). Surfaced by the CO private-gap list - missed by the state gap pass
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 40.5536,-106.0359: gravel campground loops on open sagebrush slopes beside CO-14; no water - not waterfront

name: Maybell Park
note: Town park campground on US-40 in Maybell: about 30 gravel sites, 30-amp electric on the outer ring, flush-toilet bathhouse (showers $3), dump station ($10) and water fill. RV $38 with electric (June 2026). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: town-run park campground; CampLife booking page live; Campendium (June 2026): 30 gravel sites, 30A electric, RV $38; Google 4.5 over 266; RV Life 4* over 9. Surfaced by the CO private-gap list - missed by the local gap pass
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 40.5179,-108.0865: park block in town north of US-40; no water - not waterfront

name: North Cove Campground (South Republican SWA)
note: CPW campground at the South Republican State Wildlife Area (the former Bonny Lake State Park, whose reservoir was drained): 21 dirt-pad dry sites with vault toilets, no water; 14-day limit. A CPW hunting or fishing license is required for everyone 18+ on a State Wildlife Area. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: CPW South Republican SWA page live; Campendium: 21 dirt-pad sites, vault toilets, 14-day limit, license requirement; Google 3.8 over 4. Agency-designated campground under the wildlife-agency rule (feedback_wildlife_agency_camping). Surfaced by the CO private-gap list - missed by the state gap pass
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 800 m frame) at 39.6373,-102.1864: loop road with sites on a bench above the river bottom; the Republican River channel lies ~180 m west through brush and the reservoir is drained - not waterfront

name: Monument Lake Resort
note: City of Trinidad's Monument Lake, run as a resort by a concessionaire, on CO-12 (Highway of Legends) west of Weston: full and partial hookup RV sites, primitive tent/RV spaces, cabins, lodge rooms, restaurant, marina rentals. Primitive spaces from $47.70 (2026); hookup sites $50-55 in 2025. Online booking. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: themonumentlakeresort.com live with online booking; AWH read 'Primitive Tent or RV Space - Nightly & Weekly Stays From $47.70' (2026-10-02); 2025 capture lists full hookup $55, partial $50; Google 4.4 over 15. City-owned lake park under concession -> local (no price gate)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 900 m frame) at 37.2066,-105.0465: RV loops among scattered pines just south of the lake's south end and dam, ~90 m from the water across open ground - lakeview, not lakefront

name: Mountainside RV Park
note: RV park on CO-133 at Somerset in the North Fork valley. TEMPORARILY CLOSED: the operator's site says it will not open in 2026 (read 2026-10-02) - check before planning a 2027 stay. RV Life 5*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: RV Life 5* $$ (avg ~$40), 27 sites; Google 5.0 over 66. Operator site states '***WE WILL NOT BE OPEN THIS YEAR 2026***' (AWH 2026-10-02) - added closed with a caveat per feedback_add_with_caveat_not_withhold; recheck for 2027
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 39.0264,-107.3641: buildings and RV pads in trees west of a creek that runs beside CO-133; sites not legible on the bank - not waterfront
